descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Unități de jocuri de noroc și cazinouri
Your main responsibilities 
Lead, mentor, and support a team of Frontend Developers, fostering both technical growth and professional development.
Drive the frontend architecture and ensure the implementation of scalable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, Backend Developers, and QA teams to deliver best-in-class user experiences.
Participate in technical planning, sprint activities, and roadmap discussions.
Review code, provide constructive feedback, and promote development best practices within the team.
Build reusable components and libraries for future use.
Ensure the implementation of responsive, cross-browser, and cross-platform user interfaces.
Identify technical challenges and proactively propose practical, innovative solutions.
Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and translate them into high-quality applications.
Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and performance.
Provide realistic effort estimations and contribute to project planning.
Support troubleshooting, debugging, and incident resolution when required.
Drive continuous improvements in frontend development processes, tools, and standards.
 Professional requirements 
5+ years of experience in Frontend Development.
Previous experience leading or mentoring development teams.
Strong expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks and libraries.
Good knowledge of the PixiJS framework.
Strong understanding of frontend architecture, design patterns, and scalable application development.
Experience with code reviews, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing.
Solid understanding of version control systems (Git).
Experience working within Agile development environments.
Good knowledge of Jira and Confluence.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
 Nice to have 
Experience in the iGaming industry.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development workflows.
Understanding of application performance monitoring and optimization techniques.
Experience working in distributed or international teams.
